sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:197

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:197:1
items.html: The first Hesed, and it is the one called Abraham etc., until it reaches the Yesod within him, and acquires it anew. The name Abraham refers to the Hesed of ZA at the time when it rose and became the Hochma of ZA, that is, the upper discernment of the level of AB that ZA attains through the aforementioned coupling of AA; for after he attains this level of AB, new NHY of begetting emerge for him, which are called the Yesod of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood]. Thus, through the level of Hochma that he attained from AA, which is called Abraham, ZA acquired his Yesod of Gadlut.
